title: QSOT2 -- mathematical-consistency verifier (re-scoped honest successor of the 0057 slop)
primary_purpose: Document how the errors diagnosed in the 0057 slop artifact were corrected in QSOT2, which quantities thereby became measurable and internally consistent, and what those results do and do not mean. See slop_to_measurable_map in analysis_result.json.
working_hypothesis: QSOT2 is the re-scoped mathematical-verification line of the QSOT program: it verifies the internal mathematical consistency of a phenomenological model mapping curved-spacetime curvature norms to single-qubit channels, with no external-physical-validity or first-principles claim. The governance machinery that grew on the combined line is recorded separately at 0059 and is deliberately out of scope here.

api_summary.title: QSOT2 -- mathematical-consistency verifier
api_summary.brief: Re-scoped honest successor of the 0057 slop: where 0057 emitted null placeholders (KD = 0, nm = 0) and named curved-spacetime metrics it never executed, QSOT2 computes bounded, reproducible, internally-consistent quantities and labels exactly what each one is. Math-consistency only.
api_summary.summary: QSOT2 is the mathematical-verification line of the QSOT program, migrated clean from the QSOT V2 model and harness with separated git history. It runs a 6-phase, 35-check pipeline over six spacetime backgrounds and emits a lean machine-readable result (qsot2.math_consistency.experiment_result.v1) carrying a 4-field claim boundary. Curvature drives a single-qubit channel map; purity, entropy, a flat-relative KD proxy, and a TTM-inspired backflow self-test are computed and checked, and the five temporal-state axioms hold to machine epsilon. The DEGRADED_PASS verdict is honest: the flat-baseline KD optimization does not converge within its fixed budget. Governance (phase6) is moved to experimental/ and excluded from the verdict.
findings: 34/35 checks passed, 0 skipped, 1 degraded (overall KD non-convergence) -- surfaced, not hidden
Verdict limited to model-output consistency only -- no external physical validity claimed

0057's null KD/nm placeholders replaced by a flat-relative KD delta (+0.1230) and a bounded backflow self-test (nm = 1.41e-4) cleanly separated from the Markovian-by-construction model trajectory (nm = 0)

0057's absent curved-spacetime computation replaced by deterministic per-background purity (Schwarzschild 0.99943, de Sitter 0.63607, AdS5 0.67764, Eguchi-Hanson 0.99887) under an explicit phenomenological ansatz
Numeric parity with QSOT-Harness r1 (now 0059) preserved through the clean migration; verified by the lean-schema result hash efca2228
